subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Recitar cordel e cantar repentes e emboladas, observando as rimas e obedecendo ao ritmo e à melodia.

components.description_pt: Recitar textos de literatura de cordel respeitando seus esquemas de rima características
components.description_en: Recite cordel literature texts observing their characteristic rhyme schemes
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the impact of rhyme on the meaning or effect of a specific poem or stanza

components.description_pt: Performar repentes e emboladas aderindo ao seu ritmo vocal e melodia improvisados
components.description_en: Perform repentes and emboladas adhering to their improvised vocal rhythm and melody

components.description_pt: Identificar e reproduzir padrões de rima em textos de cordel, repente e embolada
components.description_en: Identify and reproduce rhyme patterns in cordel, repente, and embolada texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify sound devices such as alliteration and rhyme in a story, poem, or song

components.description_pt: Manter ritmo apropriado ao performar gêneros de poesia oral nordestina
components.description_en: Maintain appropriate rhythm when performing northeastern Brazilian oral poetry genres
components.cc_component_description: Read grade-level prose and poetry orally with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression

cc_matches.description: Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, including figurative and connotative meanings; analyze the impact of rhymes and other repetitions of sounds (e.g., alliteration) on a specific verse or stanza of a poem or section of a story or drama.
Describe how words and phrases (e.g., regular beats, alliteration, rhymes, repeated lines) supply rhythm and meaning in a story, poem, or song.
Read with sufficient accuracy and fluency to support comprehension.
